title: Queue Craft
description: Work a review queue at a rate you can sustain without accuracy collapsing — triage, batching, honest stopping points, and rebuilding speed after time away.

title: Measuring Your Own Accuracy
description: Know your real error rate and what kind of errors you personally make — how accuracy is actually calculated, why your errors cluster, and how peer review and double-coding surface disagreement that's really ambiguity.

title: Productivity, Targets and Honesty
description: Handle volume targets without letting them quietly convert into approval-without-review — reading what a target actually does to quality, saying a target is unsafe with evidence, tracking your own throughput honestly, and negotiating accommodation.

title: The Tools You'll Actually Use
description: Work efficiently inside the encoder, EHR and review interfaces the job actually provides — what encoders and groupers decide for you, EHR navigation without a second monitor, keyboard-only and low-strain patterns, fast reference lookups, and a workstation you can use lying down.

title: Capstone — A Full Review Cycle
description: Carry a real batch from queue to corrected records to a systemic finding you escalate — taking a batch, reviewing it in your own routine, finding the pattern behind individual errors, writing the escalation, and defending your calls under challenge.
